title: Gradient-Based Co-Design of Systems and Reinforcement Learning Policies with Differentiable Simulators
abstract: arXiv:2611.19329v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Co-design is the problem of jointly optimizing the design of a system and the policy that operates it. Neither can be chosen independently: a system design is only as good as the policy trained for it, and the optimal policy changes with the design. When that policy is learned by reinforcement learning (RL), evaluating a candidate design requires a full policy training run, and the design is usually optimized by black-box search such as Bayesian optimization (BO) or evolution strategies (ES). These methods scale poorly with the design dimension and ignore the differentiable structure of modern simulators and, in particular, the sensitivity of the optimal policy with respect to the design. We instead derive a gradient-based co-design method, where the design gradient decomposes into a direct effect of changing the design at a fixed policy and an indirect effect through the design-dependent optimal policy. translated_title: 基于可微分仿真器的系统与强化学习策略梯度协同设计
translated_abstract: 协同设计是指联合优化系统设计及其运行策略的问题。二者无法独立选择：系统设计的优劣取决于为其训练的策略，而最优策略又会随设计的变化而改变。当该策略通过强化学习（RL）学习获得时，评估一个候选设计需要完整地训练一次策略，而设计通常采用贝叶斯优化（BO）或进化策略（ES）等黑盒搜索方法进行优化。这些方法在设计维度增大时扩展性较差，并且忽略了现代仿真器的可微分结构，尤其是最优策略对设计的敏感性。我们转而推导了一种基于梯度的协同设计方法，其中设计梯度可分解为两部分：在固定策略下改变设计的直接影响，以及通过依赖于设计的最优策略产生的间接影响。间接影响需要……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于可微分仿真器的梯度协同设计方法，将设计梯度分解为固定策略下的直接影响与通过设计依赖的最优策略产生的间接影响，从而克服了黑盒搜索方法扩展性差、忽略仿真器可微分结构的缺陷。
